notes.title: Another Sight - A BIG Update Has Come!
notes.notes:
Strap yourselves in - your team here at Lunar Great Wall Studios have been hard at work on a pretty significant update for Another Sight! 

As always, we pride ourselves on the fantastic fans and community that have been along the ride with us throughout the development and launch of Another Sight. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33367685/f6274cb0a738498b12ea8dda416a6e5b55a7c043.jpg

Having all of your feedback gives us an important chance to make the game even better - and boy have we been listening!

Take a look below at all the new improvements to Another Sight, including refined character control, level improvements and much more! 

Improvements on characters:

- Completely new and precise jumping system added, both for Kit and Hodge
- Improvements on cat responsiveness
- Various improvements on Kit controls
- Kit now can grab the ledges after a failed jump
- Different speed tuning on the passage from light to dark for Kit
- Different speed tuning on ladder climbing
- Different speed tuning on Kit climbing walls
- Improved physics for Hodge and Kit
- Better control on jump length for the two characters

Improvements on levels:

- Tuning on jumps difficulty level
- Better magnets behavior on level 5
- Reduced backtracking on level 5
- New cameras and lighting for introduction level

We hope you enjoy these new improvements - Another Sight is a true labour of love and we are so happy for all of your ongoing support! 

-- Team Lunar

notes.title: A New Update Has Landed on all Four Paws!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for playing Another Sight so far! Your incredible feedback and input help us to make our game EVEN better! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33367685/7a39b04362b1f94341626cff923295fcd5b1de97.jpg

Our team over at Lunar Great Wall gave been working away on a new update to implement some of your suggestions! 

Here’s what the new patch adds to Another Sight!

- Fixed particles on low framerates
- Fixed some issues on rats behavior
- Fixed some crashes on cutscene during fade
- Menu optimization in Kit's view
- Fix on Train Level 1 particles 
- Fix on air control
- Added support for DLC
- Fix on Hodge tips
- Fix on Monet Town light portal
- Improved ladder climbing behaviour
- Improved voiceover behaviour
- Improved performances on 4K when in Kit's view
- Credits update

Please keep your feedback rolling into us! 

Stay tuned for more updates soon! 

--Team Lunar

notes.title: Another Sight Release Details and Trailer!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first Another Sight announcement! 

In this post, we're very happy to share with you a brand new trailer for Another Sight as well as release details, so strap yourself in and enjoy!

We will begin with the release date news that we have to share - we're excited to announce that Another Sight will be coming to PC/STEAM on September 6th! 

What's more, you can add it to your wish list RIGHT NOW(!!) by clicking that button you know all too well!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33367685/bc61febb62e0ef18ce2e355034f169dc5eb5a0cd.jpg

But now, onto the main event - our new trailer...

This trailer explores the underlying story that will weave through Another Sight, whilst also introducing you to some of the interesting characters Kit and Hodge will meet along the way - you can watch this directly below!

 Check it out right here!
